## About
5G Auto Service & Bodyshop is a car repair shop at 1911 W Division St in Arlington. We hold a 5 rating from 24 Google reviews.
Customers tell us we're easy to deal with and fair on price. One reviewer called it "a very organized environment," and another said everyone was extremely nice to her.

## Services
- New tires: One customer got a new set from us and said we were fast getting them mounted and balanced.
- CV axle and head lamp: One customer brought in a CV axle and head lamp job after getting a dealer estimate and had us take care of it instead.

Q: Can you take care of my repair quickly?
